premises.text: Current digital experiences fail to provide true personalization due to siloed user data
premises.evidence_span: these actions are not put into a time context. What that means is Rock Out cannot distinguish between me buying a present for my friend weeks ago to an upcoming concert that I myself am attending.

premises.text: Individuals have multiple online identities that complicate personalized experiences
premises.evidence_span: a typical person has at least ten different identities, online and offline, from social handles, to alternate emails, to mobile numbers, to unique IDs from every single website and app

premises.text: Brainify creates a comprehensive profile by aggregating user data from various sources
premises.evidence_span: we create the most robust, dynamic, and encrypted profile of an individual. We do this by tying together information from across the web.

premises.text: Brainify's engine can make intelligent predictions based on time-aligned user activities
premises.evidence_span: our engine can make the most intelligent decisions and predictions specific to you right now.

premises.text: Brainify's API allows companies to deliver hyper-relevant experiences based on digital DNA
premises.evidence_span: Brainify's API allows any company to harness the power of digital DNA and deliver truly hyper-relevant experiences for every user.

premises.text: Seamless integration of Brainify's API enhances user experience on partner sites
premises.evidence_span: the data that's being sent back to Rockout will be mapped in the exact format that Rockout needs, making it a truly seamless integration.

premises.text: Brainify's digital DNA can be used for various applications beyond product recommendations
premises.evidence_span: Product recommendations are not the only place that Brainify's digital DNA is being used for today.

premises.text: Brainify's integration is quick and easy for customers to set up and maintain
premises.evidence_span: on average, our customers took one hour to get everything set up, and took next to nothing to maintain.

premises.text: Brainify offers a tiered pricing structure based on API call volume, making it affordable for all companies
premises.evidence_span: We have a tier pricing structure that's based off of the volume of API calls per month and making us easily affordable for every single company.

value.text: Users receive truly personalized experiences through the integration of digital DNA
value.evidence_span: showing them what true personalization really is with digital DNA.

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics included.
